correctness.rationale: For independent uniform Bell partitions R,S, the shared Bernoulli valuation makes the S-closed all-unmarked set F of size T_n. Direct conditional first/pair moments for the S-urn give T_n/M_S -> d=exp(-c), with conditional covariance control O(1/n); independent Stam urn M_R obeys n/M_R-r_n ->0 and M_R exp(-n/M_R)->1. For ordered k all-bad R urns inclusion-exclusion gives (M)_k(1-k/M)^(n-T) sum_{i=0}^k (-1)^i binom(k,i)(1-i/M)^T -> (exp(d)-1)^k. Fixed size-j mixed factorial moments give independent Poisson(d^j/j!). Global Diamond_R Diamond_S p is true iff there is no bad R block; P(global) -> exp(1-exp(d)). Exact Bell/Stirling conditional factorial moments and modal truth equivalence independently enumerated for n<=5/4 respectively (3873 checks); the infinite law rests on the urn proof and tightness, not finite data. Limitation: fixed c and fully independent uniform two-partition model.
